correctness.rationale: For sextic g(x²) with g(u)=u³+a u²+b u+1, squarefreeness is the nonzero cubic discriminant. Coefficients c4=b²+2a=H2 and c8=a²+2b=H1 of f(x)² give diagonal Cartier–Manin matrix, so stable rank and a-number are determined by nonzero/zero diagonal entries under Frobenius iterations. H1=0 parametrizes b=2a², H2 then yields 4a(a³-2); discriminant restricts to 2(a³-2)² mod5. Only origin is a smooth transverse intersection; three other geometric intersections have triple-root cubics and lie outside U. Singular cubics over F_q correspond bijectively to unique F_q^× double roots, q-1 total; roots of a³=2 number t_n=2+(-1)^n. Inclusion–exclusion yields N0=1,N1=2q-6-2(-1)^n,N2=q²-3q+6+2(-1)^n, and exponentiation gives stated zeta functions. Independent symbolic discriminant check and exhaustive F5 parameter scan confirmed ranks [1,6,14], q-1 singular pairs. The all-extension result is the Frobenius/root-count argument.
